title: Scenario record (v1)
description: The YAML frontmatter of a Cadence scenario record (scenarios/<id>.md) — option modeling for any commitment whose scope was negotiated against a deadline. The record that kills "wait, I thought we were getting the full version." Closure rule: a scenario is not closed until chosen_by is a named human and confirmation links their explicit reply — chosen/chosen_by/chosen_on/confirmation are therefore optional in-schema but required for closure. Source: cadence-spec.md §5.2.

id.description: Kebab-case scenario id; also the filename stem (scenarios/<id>.md).

target.description: The commitment being scoped, in plain words.

deadline.description: The date plus its nature, e.g. "2026-08-24 (external, hard)".

verdict.description: Plain-words relation to the deadline: "meets deadline", "misses deadline", "slips ~1wk".

deferred.description: Deferred scope items become first-class queue items linked back to this scenario — they can themselves be displaced later, generating their own ledger history.

options.description: At least two options — a scenario with one option is a decision already made, not a negotiation.

chosen.description: Key of the chosen option. The option name goes in the commitment record and the confirmation message (§9.2 aliasing check).

chosen_by.description: A named human, never a role or team.

confirmation.description: Link to the confirmation message AND the stakeholder's explicit reply (§9.5).
